in_sanskrit.name: दर्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is seen, the sight, vision, spectacle, or a deity that is seen. It is a common name for both boys and girls in Hinduism, and also used as a title for religious leaders who lead the devotees towards the deity during puja or darshan.

in_hindi.name: दर्श
in_hindi.long_meaning: दृश्य: देखना, दृष्टि: नजर, दर्शन: देखना सामग्री, देवता: देव

in_tamil.name: தரஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: வாழ்த்து: வழக்கு, விஜயம்: விடுதல், பார்த்து: பார்த்தல்

in_telugu.name: దర్శ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దృశ్య: దేశ, దృష్టి: దేశ్యమ్యమ్, దర్శణ: దేశయేదు

in_marathi.name: Darsh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who sees, perceives, or understands the truth, reality, or wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Darsh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sight, Vision
in_bengali.long_meaning: Darsh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who sees, perceives, or understands the truth, reality, or wisdom.
